reason: The only offered action assembles the flippers for the marble game.
expectation: I expect the blades to attach to the pivot plate, ready to fit to the table.

effect: The flippers are assembled, and I understand how the button and soft loop move and reset the paddles.
reaction: The short button moving a longer paddle is a satisfying mechanism.
reason: The only offered combination fits the assembled flippers to the marble table.
expectation: I expect the flippers to attach at the player’s end, ready to bat the marble.

effect: The flippers are now fitted to the table, so I can add targets.
reason: The only offered combination adds targets for the marble to pass through.
expectation: I expect the arches to attach to the table as targets; I’m not yet sure how they will affect scoring.

effect: The targets are fitted, so the table is ready for a marble test.
reason: The only offered combination tests the table with the marble.
expectation: I expect to launch the marble and see how the flippers and targets work; scoring may still need the score wheel.

effect: The test shows the gentle launch reaches the lower arches but suggests adjusting the stop for the top one.
reaction: The adjustable launch gives the screwdriver a clear purpose.
reason: The only offered combination appears to adjust the launcher's stop.
expectation: I expect to lengthen the launch so the marble can reach the top arch, though it may need another test.

effect: The stop now allows more spring compression while keeping the launcher enclosed and gentle; the longer launch still needs testing.
reaction: The explanation makes the adjustment clear.
reason: The only offered combination tests the adjusted launch with the marble.
expectation: I expect the marble to reach farther, possibly as far as the top arch.

effect: The longer launch reached the top arch, and the flippers can send the returning marble through another target.
reaction: Seeing the adjustment pay off in a three-arch run is satisfying.
reason: The only offered combination adds the score wheel to the tested table.
expectation: I expect the score wheel to give players a way to track their points; I’m unsure how it will operate.

effect: The score wheel is turned by hand for each arch, and the finished table is ready at the garden fair.
reaction: Jo’s attempted bonus target and the queue of one are a charming finish.

mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the longer launch was most worthwhile: it showed the adjustment working and the marble reaching all three arches across the players’ turns.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the targets was straightforward but less engaging on its own, with no explanation or decision beyond the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The adjustable stop allowed a longer launch by letting the spring compress farther, while keeping the plunger enclosed.

arbitrary.text: None felt particularly arbitrary; the screwdriver’s purpose became clear after the gentle-launch test.

continue.text: I would try another chapter for more mechanisms and their payoffs, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the single offered combinations here.
